longDeactivated.title: Konti zimaze ukwezi zihagaritswe
longDeactivated.lead: Niba aba bantu batazagaruka, ushobora gusiba konti zabo. Ibyo banditse byose bigumaho.

login.title: Abakozi: injira
login.lead: Andika izina ukoresha na PIN. Hanyuma twohereza kode y'imibare itandatu kuri imeyili yawe.
login.failed: Izina cyangwa PIN sibyo. Ongera ugerageze cyangwa usabe umuyobozi guhindura PIN.
login.inactive: Iyi konti yahagaritswe. Baza umuyobozi w'ivuriro.
login.codeLead: Twohereje kode y'imibare itandatu kuri {{email}}. Ikora iminota 10.
login.codeWrong: Kode sibyo. Reba imeyili yawe wongere ugerageze.
login.linkMismatch: Iyi link yo kwinjira ni iya {{got}}, si iya {{expected}}. Nta winjiye. Fungura imeyili iheruka koherezwa kuri {{expected}}, cyangwa wongere winjire.
login.codeOrLink: Imeyili iva kuri Muhazi Medical Clinic Ltd ifite umutwe "… is your sign-in code". Ikora iminota 10. Ntiyaje nyuma y'umunota umwe? Reba muri Spam cyangwa Promotions, cyangwa usabe indi kode.
login.error: Hari ikitagenze neza. Reba umurongo wa interineti wongere ugerageze.
login.otpSendFailed: Kode ntiyashoboye koherezwa kuri imeyili yawe. Saba umuyobozi agenzure aderesi yawe ya imeyili.
login.codeSample: Uburyo bw'igerageza: imibare itandatu iyo ari yo yose irakora.
login.trustHint: Ubutaha kuri iyi mashakisha, nimero y’umukozi, izina ukoresha na PIN birahagije — nta kode kuri imeyili kugeza igihe cyo kwizerwa kirangiye. Kuraho akamenyetso kuri mudasobwa ihuriweho.
login.firstPinLead: Ni ubwa mbere winjira ukoresheje PIN wahawe n’umuyobozi. Hitamo imibare itandatu uzi wenyine; hanyuma kode yoherezwa kuri e-mail yawe kugira ngo wemeze.
login.firstPinSaved: PIN yawe yabitswe. Andika kode tumaze kukoherereza.
login.sessionHint: Ugumamo igihe cyose ukora. Nyuma y'amasaha nta gikorwa, cyangwa iyo usohotse, uzakenera kode nshya.

ended.wrongPins: Wasohowe nyuma ya PIN 5 zitari zo kuri ecran ifunze.
ended.next: Ongera winjire: nimero y'umukozi, izina ukoresha na PIN, hanyuma kode nshya tukoherereza kuri imeyili.
ended.security: Ku bw'umutekano wawe, ongera winjire ukoresheje kode yoherejwe kuri imeri yawe.

login.notApproved: Kode ni yo, ariko sisitemu y'ivuriro ntiyashoboye kwemeza kwinjira kwawe. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'umunota umwe. Nibikomeza, bimenyeshe umuyobozi.

register.title: Kwandika umurwayi
register.lead: Andika umurwayi mushya cyangwa ugarutse, umwohereze aho agomba kujya.
register.emergency: Ibyihutirwa: ibara ritukura, aba uwa mbere ku mwanya uhitamo ukurikiraho
register.triageHint: Umurwayi ahabwa tike akajya kuri triage gupimwa bwa mbere.

done.title: Umurwayi yanditswe
done.where: Umurwayi yabitswe mu gitabo cy'abarwayi. Uruzinduko rwe rurafunguye kandi ari ku murongo wo gufatirwa ibipimo (ku muforomo), mbere yo kujya kwa muganga.
done.triageNote: Nimero yatanzwe. Umurwayi ajya gufatirwa ibipimo, hanyuma akajya aho agomba kuvurirwa.
done.emergencyNote: Ibyihutirwa: umurwayi ni we wa mbere ku murongo wa {{station}}.
done.deskNote: Itike yatanzwe. Umurwayi ari ku murongo wa {{station}}.
done.whereDesk: Umurwayi yanditswe; uruzinduko rwe rufunguye kandi ari ku murongo wa {{station}}. Fata ibipimo ukoresheje ecran y’uruzinduko cyangwa urupapuro rw’Ibipimo.

register.emergencyHint: Hanyuma uhitemo umwanya (uwawe niba umwakira ubwawe). Andika dosiye ubu cyangwa umurwayi nakomera.
register.searchLabel: Shakisha ukoresheje izina, nimero ya dosiye, telefoni cyangwa indangamuntu
register.noMatch: Nta murwayi wabonetse. Andika dosiye nshya iburyo.

errors.openVisit: Uyu murwayi asanzwe afite uruzinduko rufunguye.

noId.label: Indangamuntu
noId.childHint: Ku mwana, andika telefoni y’umubyeyi cyangwa umurera n’izina rye nk’uwo guhamagara mu gihe cyihutirwa muri dosiye.

register.deskHint: Umurwayi ahabwa itike akajya aho wahisemo. Ibipimo bishobora gufatirwa aho, cyangwa mbere n’umuforomo.

fileOnly.title: Dosiye nshya y’umurwayi
fileOnly.hint: Hafungurwa dosiye gusa ubu; uruzinduko rutangira umurwayi ageze kuri gahunda. Dosiye nshya ihita ihitwamo kuri gahunda.

register.flow: Shaka umurwayi cyangwa wandike dosiye nshya, hanyuma uhitemo aho ajya.
register.flowTriageFirst: Shaka umurwayi cyangwa wandike dosiye nshya. “Gupimwa mbere” birakora: umurwayi abanza kubona umuforomo, keretse umwakiriye ubwawe.
register.savedOnly: Dosiye ya {{name}} yabitswe ({{file}}). Nta ruzinduko rwatangiye: koresha “Tangira uruzinduko” umurwayi niteguye.

triage.title: Ibipimo
triage.empty: Abarwayi bose bari mu ivuriro bafite ibipimo.
triage.select: Hitamo umurwayi ibumoso kugira ngo wandike ibipimo.
triage.readOnly: Abaforomo na ba muganga ni bo bonyine bandika ibipimo.
triage.lockedFor: Yoherejwe kwa {{name}}: ni {{name}} wenyine ufata ibipimo akohereza uyu murwayi aho akurikira. Ushobora kureba ariko ntugire icyo uhindura.
triage.lockedSection: Abaforomo bakora aho bafatira ibipimo (triage) ni bo bonyine bafata ibipimo bakohereza uyu murwayi aho akurikira. Ushobora kureba ariko ntugire icyo uhindura.

settings.title: Igenamiterere ry'ivuriro
settings.lead: Uyobora ivuriro ryose uhereye hano: umwirondoro n'aho twandikirwa bigaragara ku rubuga, amasaha dufungura, n'inzira zigana kuri buri gice.

profile.title: Umwirondoro w'ivuriro
profile.lead: Bigaragara ku rubuga rusange, ku nyemezabwishyu no mu butumwa. Impinduka zigaragara ako kanya.

hours.title: Amasaha dufungura
hours.lead: Kuri buri munsi: amasaha 24, amasaha wihitiyemo cyangwa rirafunze. Laboratwari ifite amasaha yayo.

patientFields.title: Ibice bya dosiye y'umurwayi
patientFields.lead: Ongeraho amakuru ivuriro ryifuza kuri buri dosiye y'umurwayi arenze asanzwe (idini, indwara idakira, umuntu wa hafi, nimero y'ikarita y'ubwishingizi…). Abakozi bayuzuza kuri dosiye y'umurwayi.
patientFields.label: Izina ry'igice
patientFields.optionsPh: Nta yo, Diyabete, Umuvuduko w'amaraso, SIDA, Asima
patientFields.saved: Ibice byabitswe. Ubu bigaragara kuri buri dosiye y'umurwayi.
patientFields.privateHint: ababona ni abavura umurwayi n'abemerewe kubona amateka yose; kwakira abarwayi bishobora kuyuzuza iyo irimo ubusa ariko ntibayibona

lock.title: Gufunga ecran
lock.lead: Iyo nta muntu ukoze kuri ecran y'umukozi muri iki gihe, irifunga igasaba PIN. Umunota umwe mbere, haza integuza; gukoraho cyangwa gukanda bituma igumaho. Gufunga bigumana urupapuro uko rwari ruri, nta kazi kabura.
lock.saved: Byabitswe. Kuva ubu ecran zose z'abakozi zirabikoresha.

otp.title: Kode yo kwinjira kuri imeyili
otp.lead: Kode zoherezwa na Gmail y’ivuriro, yemera imeyili nka 500 ku munsi. Nyuma ya kode imwe nyayo umuntu ashobora kwizera igikoresho cye; kuri icyo gikoresho nimero y’umukozi, izina ukoresha na PIN biba bihagije kugeza igihe cyo kwizerwa kirangiye.
otp.days_one: Rimwe kuri buri gikoresho, hanyuma cyizerwa umunsi {{count}}
otp.days_other: Rimwe kuri buri gikoresho, hanyuma cyizerwa iminsi {{count}}
otp.revokeAll: Ongera usabe kode ku bikoresho byose
otp.saved: Byabitswe. Birakurikizwa uhereye ku kwinjira gukurikira.
otp.hint: Koresha "Ongera usabe kode ku bikoresho byose" iyo telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa ibuze, cyangwa umukozi avuye mu ivuriro.

beds.title: Ibitanda n’igiciro cy’ijoro
beds.lead: Umubare w’ibitanda ivuriro rifite n’igiciro cy’ijoro rimwe. Abakozi babona ibitanda biri ubusa, kandi kurara byishyurwa amajoro × iki giciro (cyangwa igiciro cyemeranyijweho).
beds.mixed: Ibitanda bifite ibiciro bitandukanye. Andika igiciro kugira ngo byose bigire kimwe, cyangwa uhindure buri gitanda hasi.
beds.name: Izina ry’igitanda

settings.leadShort: Ibyo ushyiraho byose ku ivuriro, igice ku kindi.

access.title: Ukora iki
access.hint: Ibikorwa kuri buri mwanya na buri mukozi

flow.title: Inzira y’umurwayi
flow.deskFirstHint: Kwakira abarwayi bohereza umurwayi kwa muganga (cyangwa ahandi). Ibipimo bifatirwa aho cyangwa n’umuforomo ku rupapuro rw’Ibipimo.
flow.triageFirstHint: Buri murwayi anyura kuri triage: umuforomo afata ibipimo, ahitamo ibara, akohereza umurwayi.
flow.saved: Byabitswe. Abandikishwa bashya bakurikiza iyi nzira.
flow.vitalsNote: Uko byagenda kose, buri ecran yerekana niba ibipimo byafashwe.

session.title: Igihe cyo kuba winjiye
session.lead_one: Ecran iguma yinjiye igihe cyose ikoreshwa. Nyuma y'isaha {{count}} nta gikorwa, irasohoka, kandi kongera kwinjira bisaba kode nshya yoherejwe kuri imeyili.
session.lead_other: Ecran iguma yinjiye igihe cyose ikoreshwa. Nyuma y'amasaha {{count}} nta gikorwa, irasohoka, kandi kongera kwinjira bisaba kode nshya yoherejwe kuri imeyili.
session.rule1_one: Buri paji ibara ibikorwa byayo: gukanda, kwandika, gukora kuri ecran cyangwa kumanura. Nyuma y'isaha {{count}} nta na kimwe, paji irasohoka.
session.rule1_other: Buri paji ibara ibikorwa byayo: gukanda, kwandika, gukora kuri ecran cyangwa kumanura. Nyuma y'amasaha {{count}} nta na kimwe, paji irasohoka.
session.rule2: Iminota 10 mbere, haza ubutumwa bwo kuburira; gukanda cyangwa kwandika bigumisha umuntu muri sisitemu.
session.rule3: Gusohoka, cyangwa PIN 5 zitari zo kuri ecran ifunze, bisohora paji zose z'uwo muntu muri iyi mushakisha, kandi kwinjira gukurikira bisaba kode nshya yoherejwe kuri imeyili.
session.rule4_one: Indi paji muri iyo mushakisha yinjira ikoresheje nimero y'umukozi, izina ukoresha na PIN, nta kode nshya, igihe cyose uwo muntu yakoze muri yo mu isaha {{count}} ishize.
session.rule4_other: Indi paji muri iyo mushakisha yinjira ikoresheje nimero y'umukozi, izina ukoresha na PIN, nta kode nshya, igihe cyose uwo muntu yakoze muri yo mu masaha {{count}} ashize.
session.rule5: “Funga ecran ubu” igumisha akazi gafunguye inyuma ya PIN; igihe ecran imaze ifunze kibarwa nk'igihe nta gikorwa.
session.saved: Byabitswe. Ecran zifunguye zikurikiza amasaha mashya mu minota mike.
session.revokeHint: “Ongera usabe kode ku bikoresho byose” ihagarika urufunguzo rwa buri mushakisha: kwinjira gukurikira kwa buri wese bisaba kode nshya yoherejwe kuri imeyili. Ecran zisanzwe zinjiye zigumamo.

pin.changeLead: Winjiye ukoresheje PIN wahawe n'umuyobozi. Yisimbuze imibare itandatu uzi wenyine.
pin.failed: PIN ntiyashoboye guhindurwa. Reba PIN isanzwe wongere ugerageze.

lock.title: Byafunzwe nyuma y'iminota 5
lock.soon_one: Nta gikorwa: ecran irifunga mu isegonda {{count}}.
lock.soon_other: Nta gikorwa: ecran irifunga mu masegonda {{count}}.
lock.wrongLeft_one: PIN si yo. Usigaje igerageza {{count}} mbere yo gusohorwa.
lock.wrongLeft_other: PIN si yo. Usigaje amagerageza {{count}} mbere yo gusohorwa.
lock.idleSignOut_one: Niba ecran idafunguwe bitarenze {{time}} (isaha {{count}} nta gikorwa), urasohorwa kandi uzakenera kode nshya yoherejwe kuri imeyili.
lock.idleSignOut_other: Niba ecran idafunguwe bitarenze {{time}} (amasaha {{count}} nta gikorwa), urasohorwa kandi uzakenera kode nshya yoherejwe kuri imeyili.

add.adjust: Igabanywa cyangwa guhindura igiciro (igabanywa kugeza kuri {{max}} %)
add.adjustHint: Si ngombwa. Andika 10 kuri 10 %, hitamo RWF ku mafaranga, cyangwa × ku kigwizo.

errors.noManual: Ubu buvuzi ntibwemera ikindi giciro. Koresha igabanywa, cyangwa usabe umuyobozi gushyiraho "Muganga ashobora kwandika ikindi giciro".
errors.discount: Igabanywa ni ijanisha riri hagati ya 0 na 100.
errors.overMax: Ushobora gutanga kugeza kuri {{pct}}% kuri ubu buvuzi. Saba umuyobozi kurenzaho.

add.title: Ongeraho ubuvuzi
add.medicinesElsewhere: Imiti yandikirwa mu nyandiko y’ubuvuzi (Andika umuti); hano wongeramo ubuvuzi na serivisi.
add.otherWarning: Ubu buvuzi ni ubw’irindi shami. Bwongeremo gusa niba koko ari wowe ubutanze hano (urugero iyo nta mukozi w’iryo shami uhari).

payer.title: Uwishyura
payer.label: Uwishyura
payer.hint: Guhitamo ubwishingizi byongera kugabanya buri cyishyurwa kuri iyi fagitire hakurikijwe ibyo bwishyura.
payer.noInsurers: Nta bwishingizi burakora: umurwayi yishyura amafaranga yose kuri kasiye.

payment.title: Kwishyura
payment.nothingYet: Nta cyishyurwa kiraba kuri uru ruzinduko.
payment.settledOpen: Ibyishyuwe kugeza ubu. Inyemezabwishyu {{receipt}}. Uruzinduko rurakomeje: ibyongerwaho bizishyurwa ku iherezo.

next.title: Intambwe ikurikira y’uyu murwayi
next.lead: Iyo urangije hano, ohereza umurwayi aho akurikiraho. Bifunga umwanya we ku murongo wa {{station}}; umurwayi agaragara ku murongo w’aho wahisemo.
next.sectionLead: Urangije hano, hitamo icyo umurwayi akeneye gukurikiraho. Umuntu wese ukora muri icyo gice ashobora kumwakira, yaba muganga cyangwa umuforomo (uwa mbere ubonetse), cyangwa uhitemo umuntu umwe.

visit.closedBanner: Uruzinduko rwarangiye {{when}}. Ibyanditswe byose bigumye muri dosiye y’umurwayi.
visit.cashierNote: Ibipimo, ubuvuzi n’imiti byongerwamo n’abaganga n’abaforomo. Hano wakira ubwishyu.
visit.takeHint: Ni wowe umwitaho ubu: abo mukorana babona ko ari wowe.

refund.title: Subiza amafaranga
refund.lead: Hari igikorwa cyavanyweho nyuma yo kwishyurwa: umurwayi yishyuye arenze fagitire. Subiza ikinyuranyo kandi uvuge impamvu.

patients.title: Abarwayi
patients.lead: Buri murwayi ivuriro ryanditse, n’idosiye ye yose.
patients.none: Nta murwayi uhuye n'ubushakashatsi. Reba uko izina ryanditswe cyangwa umwandike.

merge.title: Huza dosiye yanditswe kabiri
merge.lead: Umuntu umwe yanditswe kabiri? Shaka indi dosiye: inzinduko zayo, gahunda, inyandiko n’ubwishingizi biza muri iyi dosiye, kandi nimero yayo ikomeza kubona umurwayi.
merge.done_one: {{dup}} yahujwe: ikintu {{count}} cyimuriwe muri iyi dosiye.
merge.done_other: {{dup}} yahujwe: ibintu {{count}} byimuriwe muri iyi dosiye.

file.visitStarted: Uruzinduko rwatangiye. Nimero {{ticket}}, ari ku murongo wa {{station}}.
file.moreLead: Ibice umuyobozi yongeyeho mu Igenamiterere bigaragara hano kuri buri murwayi. Ushobora no kongeraho igice cyihariye cy'uyu murwayi gusa.
file.fieldNamePh: urugero: Umuntu wa hafi, Idini, Nimero y'ikarita y'ubwishingizi
file.noExtra: Nta yandi makuru araba. Koresha “Ongeraho igice”, cyangwa umuyobozi ashyireho ibice bya buri murwayi mu Igenamiterere.
file.allergiesHint: Imiti, ibiryo cyangwa ibindi bitera umubiri kwivumbura (uduheri, kubyimba, guhumeka nabi) gusa. Ibindi bivugwa bijya mu Byitonderwa.
file.inClinicNow: Uyu murwayi ari mu ivuriro ubu, ategereje kuri {{station}}. Akabuto k'ubururu gafungura urwo ruzinduko: ibipimo, ibyanditswe, indwara, ubuvuzi, imiti n'ubwishyu byose byandikwa aho.
file.allergiesNoneHint: Kanda hano igihe umurwayi yabajijwe akaba nta allergie izwi afite. Bigaragara ku mpapuro z'imiti no kuri raporo.

clinical.title: Inyandiko z'ubuvuzi
clinical.readOnly: Ba muganga, abaforomo n'umuyobozi ni bo bonyine bandika mu nyandiko z'ubuvuzi.
clinical.notePh: Icyamuzanye, amateka, ibyagaragaye mu isuzuma, gahunda…
clinical.testSaved: Ikizamini cyasabwe, cyishyuzwa kandi gishyirwa ku murongo.
clinical.finishHint: Indwara y'ingenzi irakenewe. Niba hari amafaranga atarishyurwa, umurwayi yoherezwa kuri kasiye.
clinical.finishConfirm: Gusoza uru ruzinduko? Ibizamini bitararangira biguma bifunguye; fagitire itishyuwe yohereza umurwayi kuri kasiye.

errors.needPrimary: Andika indwara y'ingenzi mbere yo gusoza uruzinduko.
errors.rxTwice: {{names}} cyanditswe kabiri. Kuramo umurongo urenze, cyangwa wongere ukande Andika imiti kugira ngo byombi bitangwe (buri kimwe kirishyurwa).
errors.pickStore: Hitamo ububiko bw'icyumba buri muti utangwa hano uvamo.

clinical.dxHint: Indwara ni icyo wabonye nyuma yo gusuzuma umurwayi, urugero “Malariya yoroheje”. Iy'ingenzi = impamvu nyamukuru y'uru ruzinduko; iyindi = ibindi bibazo byabonetse. Kanda “By'agateganyo” igihe ugitegereje ibisubizo.
clinical.rxHint: Igice kimwe kuri buri muti. Koresha “Ongeraho undi muti” ku miti ifatanywa (urugero umuti wa malariya na parasetamoli). Yose yoherezwa muri farumasi icyarimwe.
clinical.rxSaved_one: Umuti wanditswe. Umurwayi ari ku murongo wa farumasi.
clinical.rxSaved_other: Imiti {{count}} yanditswe. Umurwayi ari ku murongo wa farumasi.
clinical.closedNote: Uru ruzinduko rwarangiye: ibyanditswe hasi ni ibyo gusoma gusa kandi bigumye muri dosiye y’umurwayi.
clinical.icdHint: ICD-10 ni kode mpuzamahanga y’indwara (B54 = malariya, A01.0 = tifoyide). Si ngombwa; iyo ishyizwemo, raporo zibara indwara nk’uko Minisiteri y’Ubuzima ibikora.
clinical.provisionalHint: Kanda “By’agateganyo” iyo ukeka indwara ariko utarayemeza (urugero utegereje ikizamini). Ntukande iyo indwara yemejwe.
clinical.testHint: Nta ndwara isabwa kubanza kumenywa: saba ibikenewe kugira ngo umenye impamvu. Umurwayi ajya aho bikorerwa; ibisubizo bijya muri dosiye.
clinical.noTests: Nta kizamini cya laboratwari cyangwa echographie kiri mu rutonde.
clinical.sendNow: Ohereza umurwayi ubu, agaruke kuri njye ibisubizo nibimara kuboneka
clinical.testsSent_one: Ikizamini cyasabwe. Umurwayi agiye aho bapimira, azagaruka iwawe afite igisubizo.
clinical.testsSent_other: Ibizamini {{count}} byasabwe. Umurwayi agiye aho bapimira, azagaruka iwawe afite ibisubizo.
clinical.correctionPh: urugero: ikirango kitari cyo, ikosa ryo kwandika
clinical.roomUnpriced: Nta giciro cya {{names}}: ntibiri kuri fagitire.
clinical.roomNoStock: Nta muti uhagije (utararenza igihe) mu bubiko ushobora gukuramo: wandike ngo uzatangwe na farumasi.
clinical.returned: {{item}} yasubiye mu bubiko kandi yavanywe kuri fagitire.
clinical.testsWhoTitle: Ba muganga ni bo bonyine basaba ibizamini. Umuyobozi ashobora kubyemera muri Igenamiterere → Ukora iki.
clinical.testsWhoHint: Ba muganga ni bo basaba ibizamini (na laboratwari cyangwa echographie, ku biro byabo bwite); umuyobozi ashobora kubyemerera abandi muri Igenamiterere → Ukora iki. Ubuvuzi utanga hano bushyirwa muri Ongeraho ubuvuzi.

rxWarn.prescribingRule: Itegeko rya RHIA {{rule}}: ubuhanga bwawe ntibuhuye. Umwishingizi ashobora kwanga kuwishyura.
rxWarn.needsNote: RHIA: umwishingizi asaba inyandiko isobanura impamvu ({{rule}}).
rxWarn.title: Byandikiwe, ariko bigenzure
rxWarn.noSpecialty: Nta buhanga bwanditswe kuri konti yawe.
rxWarn.hint: Ibyanditswe byabitswe. Ubwishingizi bushobora kwanga kwishyura umuti wanditswe hatubahirijwe amabwiriza yawo.

clinical.cancelRxWhy: Kuki uyu muti uhagaritswe? Farumasi izabimenyeshwa.

clinical.cancelRxHint: Kuraho uyu muti mbere y'uko farumasi iwutanga
clinical.cancelHint: Farumasi irabimenyeshwa kandi ntizawutanga. Nta kiguzi cyawo kizishyurwa.
clinical.returnOpenHint: Umuti usubira mu bubiko bwa farumasi kandi ukurwa kuri fagitire.
clinical.returnClosedHint: Uru ruzinduko rwarafunzwe: umuti usubira mu bubiko bwa farumasi kandi hakorwa inyandiko yo gusubiza amafaranga. Ayo umurwayi yawishyuye ayasubizwa kuri kesi.
clinical.returnedCreditNone: {{item}} wasubijwe mu bubiko. Umurwayi nta cyo yawishyuye, nta kimusubizwa; ibyo ubwishingizi busabwa biragabanywa.

roomStock.label: Uvanwa mu bubiko bw'icyumba
roomStock.noStores: Nta bubiko bw'icyumba bufunguye. Wohereze kuri farumasi.

confirm.request: Gusaba kubona amakuru y’ingendo zabanje za {{name}}?
confirm.requestBody: Umuyobozi n’abakuriye amashami babona ubutumwa burimo impamvu yawe. Umwe nabwemera, uzabona amakuru y’ingendo zabanje kugeza uru ruzinduko rurangiye.

confirm.cancelBody: Umuyobozi n’abakuriye amashami ntibazongera kububona. Ushobora kongera gusaba nyuma.
